source: Held-out test sets, greedy decoding, checkpoints chosen on a separate validation split. Counts are correct/total. Source: RESULTS_V5.md.
caveat: Honest reading: MAPPO modestly beats the small SFT on unusual injections (not statistically significant across 3 seeds: seeds 0/1/2 scored 46/40/43 on Q4), and a larger, more varied SFT set beats MAPPO. 0.5B model; MAPPO from scratch without an SFT start did not learn the task.
